switching_note: the OmniProbe desktop app started at 17:54:54 but had no serial session yet; the first state check fell back to the direct port and failed with PermissionError(13) because the app already held COM6. Six polls of probe_bridge_serial later the app had attached, and every later command went through 127.0.0.1:8765. Nothing else was needed: no re-plug, no baud scan.

abort_note.what: the orchestrator process disappeared mid-round; the orphan ndjson standard255_195_target275_peakwindow_20261120-183054.ndjson ends right after [Deflate] PWM started after hold, with no metadata and no export
abort_note.why: the agent shell that owned the background job was restarted, which killed the job and its child python processes. Not a firmware or pneumatic fault: the seven rounds that finished before it are all export_received with closeout confirmed, and the fixture was left vented.
abort_note.cleanup: the 21 completed files plus the orphan ndjson were moved to tmp/omniprobe/quarantine_20261120/; data/raw keeps only this card, and the manifest was never written for day 5, so D5 restarts from round 1
abort_note.zero_after: the sealed zero read +1.11 after the abort against -0.79 at open. OmniProbe was restarted and MCU fault code=4 SENSOR_READ was latched (recoveries=1), which is the same latched-but-recovered state D2 started from. Still inside the +/-5.0 gate.
